slot_scores.name: product_I_no_production_Q2
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether Product I can be produced in Q2 or whether any product has quarter-specific production restrictions.

slot_scores.name: contract_reservations_must_be_delivered
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For each quarter, is the contract reservation quantity a minimum amount that must be delivered to the customer (meaning any shortfall incurs the delay compensation cost), or is it a target that can be exceeded without penalty?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether reservations are required deliveries and, in turn 2, whether undelivered units remain in inventory for later delivery, covering the late-delivery/firm-demand semantics.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Product I can be produced in Q2; no quarter-specific production restriction applies.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about Product I Q2 production restrictions, and the READY_TO_MODEL model lists only general capacity and inventory constraints, implicitly allowing production of Product I in Q2.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while P1 slot H1, the Product I Q2 production prohibition, remained entirely unasked and unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several demand, backlog, capacity, and integrality issues, but it missed the Product I no-production-in-Q2 restriction, leaving a P1 hidden slot unresolved before READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
